subject: HelioHealth trial: success KPIs & ops rundown
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Suresh Rao <suresh@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed trial KPIs (HelioHealth)

Hi Suresh — great to connect this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps after our discovery: 

Summary of ask
- You want a short (3-week) technical trial that validates: 1) latency/throughput for your clinical triage workload, 2) per-interaction cost estimates, 3) response quality on our medical-intent prompts.

Proposed success criteria (we recommended thresholds; open to your adjustments)
- Latency: P50 < 120ms, P95 < 350ms at target concurrency (see throughput below)
- Throughput: sustain 40 RPS (end-to-end) with <= 5% dropped requests during steady-state
- Cost: estimated cost/token <= $0.0008 for production-like traffic (we'll provide post-trial breakdown)
- Quality: macro F1/precision on the classification prompts >= 0.88; top-1 human accept rate >= 85% on a 200-sample blind review; hallucination rate < 3% on targeted prompts

Scope & deliverables
- Redwood provides a sandbox endpoint + config for quantization and batching parameters, a runbook (ops playbook), and a short sample workload template.
- HelioHealth provides: representative sample workload (CSV), success-eval rubric, and 2 SME reviewers for the blind-quality pass.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): share sample workload and sign mutual action plan
- Week 1: onboarding + smoke test + baseline run (latency/cost baseline)
- Week 2: optimization window (batching/quant / routing) and high-load run
- Week 3: blind-quality review, readout, recommendations and next-step commercial discussion

Owners / asks
- Ben: commercial lead and procurement coordination (contract sketch and credits)
- Jonas: technical onboarding + runway (will run the load tests; cc'd)
- Lauren: Will handle any contract terms / procurement checklist

Attachments: I attached a sample workload template for your team to populate and a draft runbook.

Next steps
- Suresh / Maya: confirm the sample workload delivery by EOD Thu (9 Jul) and confirm SME reviewers
- We (Redwood): will send an official MAP and access details after we receive the sample workload

Thanks again — happy to tweak numbers if your infra constraints differ.

Best,
Ben

From: Suresh Rao <suresh@heliohealth.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed trial KPIs (HelioHealth)

Thanks Ben — this is very helpful. Quick replies inline: 

- Latency targets look reasonable, though for live triage our P95 goal is ideally < 300ms. If you can get P95 under 300ms that would be a strong win.
- Throughput: 40 RPS is fine for our pilot. We'll also want to run a spike test to 80 RPS for 5 minutes to validate graceful degradation/fallback behavior.
- Cost: the target cost/token looks acceptable as long as the final per-session cost math is documented.
- Quality: the blind review process works. We'll assign two clinicians (SMEs) to do the 200-sample pass. Can you confirm how you compute 'hallucination rate'? We need a simple definition for the SMEs.

We will:
- Fill the sample workload by Fri 10 Jul EOD and share access to an internal doc describing the prompts/context.
- Confirm SME reviewers by Mon 13 Jul.

Question for Redwood: how will you isolate this sandbox from other customers (data isolation, logging) and what logs will be accessible to us for analysis? We may need that detail for security/compliance.

-Suresh
Suresh Rao | VP Product, HelioHealth
suresh@heliohealth.com | +1 617-555-9876

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Suresh Rao <suresh@heliohealth.com>, Maya Patel <maya@heliohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed trial KPIs (HelioHealth)

Thanks — good signal from the call. I will start the technical onboarding and document the ops guardrails. Action items I am committing to below (Jonas - T for technical owner):

1) Onboarding & isolation (T: Jonas) — deliver by Fri 10 Jul
   - Provision sandbox endpoint on dedicated namespace (single-tenant routing for trial)
   - Enable request/response and KV cache logs (redacted PII) and share a logging spec
   - Provide an access matrix for who at HelioHealth can view logs and how long we retain them (30 days by default for trial)

2) Baseline latency/throughput runs (T: Jonas + Stephanie) — Week 1 run (Mon 13 Jul)
   - Baseline: 5-minute steady-state at 40 RPS, record P50/P95/P99 and token counts
   - Spike: 5-minute burst to 80 RPS to observe degradation curves and fallback behaviors
   - Deliverable: baseline report with plots and raw CSVs

3) Cost modeling (T: Ben) — provide a per-session and per-100k token cost estimate by Tue 14 Jul
   - Ben: please include assumptions (quantization level, batching, avg tokens/session)

4) Quality evaluation (T: Lauren + Helio SMEs) — Week 3 blind pass and readout
   - Provide evaluation rubric and hallucination definition (suggest: hallucination = output asserting a specific clinical fact not present in prompt or supported by provided context)
   - Lauren: prepare a short reviewer guide for clinicians (how to flag hallucinations and edge cases)

5) Ops runbook updates (T: Stephanie) — finalize runbook v1 with incident playbook and escalation matrix by Tue 14 Jul

Notes on metrics and instrumentation
- We'll collect per-request: request_id, model_variant, prompt_length_tokens, completion_tokens, total_latency_ms, backend_gpu_ms, batching_delay_ms, route_id.
- Compute cost/token by dividing total GPU ms * cost-per-ms by tokens generated; we'll present both raw and amortized numbers.

Attachments: I uploaded a first-pass onboarding checklist to the shared Drive (link in metadata).

If everyone's comfortable, I'll spin up the sandbox namespace today and send creds to Suresh/Maya after their workload is in S3.

Jonas
